structure.unit: Regulation of Medical Care Facilities and Services
Prescribed Pediatric Extended Care Center Licensing

law.catch_line: (Effective July 1, 2026) Compliance with Uniform Statewide Building Code
law.text: Buildings licensed as Centers shall be classified by and meet the specifications for the proper Use Group as required by the Uniform Statewide Building Code (§ 36-97 et seq.).
